chunks: Al-Fuḍayl ibn Yasār narrated from him that he said:

"Indeed, the houses in which salat (prayer) is performed at night with the recitation of the Qur'an shine for the inhabitants of the heaven just as the stars of the sky shine for the inhabitants of the earth."

key_terms.الْبُيُوتَ: the homes or houses being described as spiritually radiant
key_terms.الْقُرْآنِ: the Qur'an being recited in worship

ai.seo_question: How do houses of night salat (prayer) and Qur'an recitation appear to the inhabitants of the heavens?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the spiritual radiance of homes in which night salat (prayer) and Qur'an recitation are established. It emphasizes that worship performed in the home has a manifest effect in the unseen realm, making such houses luminous to the inhabitants of the heavens.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1367 - Al-Fudayl ibn Yasar reported from him (Abu Abdullah (as)) who said:

"Indeed, the houses in which the Qur'an is recited during the night and where prayer is performed shine for the inhabitants of the heavens just as the stars of the sky shine for the inhabitants of the earth."
